Radiographic Testing (RT) Level 2 Course

Radiographic Testing (RT) Level II training with a dedicated film-interpretation practicum — source selection, IQI sensitivity verification, film density reading, and weld-discontinuity identification (porosity, slag, lack of fusion, cracking) against ASME Section V Article 2 exposure technique and ASME VIII / B31.3 acceptance criteria.
